defects.claim: Active joint is stored by name only, so switching rigs silently selects another rig's joint with the same name
defects.scenario: Select a different rig whose auto-generated joint names repeat; the bone and weight actions act on its matching joint
defects.cause: joint identity keyed by name without rig

defects.claim: Weight stroke re-resolves the rig per dab with the joint name captured at press, so a mid-gesture rig change commits edits to two rigs
defects.scenario: Selected or externally supplied rig changes during a weight stroke; the pending map collects edits from both rigs and commits them as one

defects.claim: sceneReach uses the larger world extent as a circular radius, so under nonuniform zoom, joint picking and the brush overreach what is drawn on screen
defects.scenario: View with unequal axis scales; input along the more magnified axis reaches beyond the displayed dot or brush ring
defects.cause: scalar world radius for an anisotropic screen-space reach
